correctness.rationale: The endpoint unit constraint yields f(0)=1-m_f. Substitute f′=m_f+δ_f into ||f+g||=f(0)+g(0)+max(f′+g′) to obtain exactly 2+max(δ_f+δ_g). To prove the converse, test against all nonnegative continuous derivatives u<=1 and use continuous peaked u(x)=1: inf_{u(x)=1}max(δ+u)=1+δ(x), including points with δ=-1. Thus equal pairwise profiles imply δ_f=δ_h. Writing derivative δ+M and initial value 1-M gives precisely -min δ <=M<=1; any onto self-map of each interval preserves all pairs and is globally onto. Checked singleton fiber and δ=0 affine fiber. No finite enumeration is needed.
